parsed.note_claim: King Charles had his Lord Chamberlain issue a letter enforcing the Sandringham Agreement that was agreed by the Sussexes and the RF in 2020.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The message from the King emphasises that the position agreed in 2020 when the Sussexes left the UK - the so-called Sandringham Agreement - is still in place.
parsed.reason: The article directly confirms the King's letter enforces the Sandringham Agreement from 2020, substantiating the note's specific factual claim.
